findings.what: The ranking count Vista sees is flattered by brand terms
findings.ev: Semrush top-3 count 59 → 106 → 97 (Jul 2025–Jul 2026) after the tracked set grew from 150 to 201 keywords; 60–70 of the top-3 terms each month are brand or near-zero volume. Meanwhile 'lasik surgery' (3,600/mo) went 5 → 21 and 'cataract surgery' (3,600/mo) 7 → 23 → out of the top 100. Organic sessions were never reported.
findings.fix: Report organic visitors and enquiries first; track a commercial keyword set agreed with Vista; brand terms shown separately.

findings.what: 16 centres, 101 location URLs, no H1 on any of them
findings.ev: 74 duplicate, legacy or copied location URLs return 200 and sit in the sitemap (5 PJ-HQ copies in BM and 5 in ZH, hub copies, /locations-old/, EN pages under a Chinese slug). 0 of 75 location pages carry an H1; none has LocalBusiness markup; 9 of 16 centre pages have 78–109 words. Phone formats differ on 3 pages; the enquiry form lists 14 of 16 centres. Google Business Profile: 13 listings plus a duplicate HQ listing, keyword-stuffed names.
findings.fix: One canonical page per centre per language with markup; 74 URLs redirected; 16 verified listings with real names; centre × service tracking.

findings.what: Sitemap omits two years of content; three languages on broken URLs
findings.ev: The sitemap lists 224 URLs but none of the 52 posts published in 2025–2026. 0 hreflang tags on 379 pages; languages served on ?lang= query strings; 37 of 43 Mandarin pages on percent-encoded slugs. On vistanow.com.my, 156 BM/ZH pages canonicalise to the English URL and 31 of 39 ZH posts are untranslated English.
findings.fix: Clean /ms/ and /zh/ routes with hreflang on the new site; every post in the sitemap; vistanow content migrated and the domain redirected.

findings.what: Content arrives in batches and has stopped
findings.ev: vista.com.my: 55 posts in 24 months, 24 of them in April 2026. vistanow.com.my: 109 posts, 83 in Mar–May 2026. Nothing on either site since May 2026; 15 of 24 months had zero output. At least 10 press clippings duplicated across both domains. The content hub has no active link from the main site.
findings.fix: Four medically reviewed articles a month on the main site from Month 2, planned from the keyword map; quarterly refresh of top pages.

findings.what: No medical structured data; 20 doctors share one page
findings.ev: Markup is the CMS default (Organization, WebPage, Breadcrumb, Article); LocalBusiness on the English home page only. No MedicalOrganization, MedicalClinic, Physician or MedicalProcedure on either domain. 20 ophthalmologists listed on one /doctors page with no individual URLs, portraits with empty alt text. 176 of 379 pages have no meta description.
findings.fix: Full medical schema set; a profile page per doctor; FAQ blocks per service; meta data generated from the CMS with a check in CI.

findings.what: Mandarin and Malay demand is real and under-served
findings.ev: GA4 language settings: Mandarin 9%, Malay 6–10%, Indonesian 2–4% of users; Google Ads already runs full CN and BM campaign sets; TikTok output is 100% BM. On the website the Mandarin pages sit on broken slugs and most ZH posts are untranslated.
findings.fix: Every service and centre page in EN, BM and ZH with hreflang; BM-first for kids and dry eye; ZH-first for cataract and refractive; the CNY campaign lands on the ZH site.

findings.what: AI assistants already send patients — nobody measures it
findings.ev: GA4 'AI Assistant' channel: 282 sessions in 20 months, 7 in May 2026 rising to 134 in August 2026, with 89–92% engagement; chatgpt.com appears under four different mediums because the channel grouping was never set up.
findings.fix: Channel grouping fixed in Month 1; prompt-library baseline on five engines by Day 30; citation-ready content standard from Month 2.
